items.title: Steve Angrum Interview, 1961-08-08
items.q: I never heard him much. I never didn't worry about him too much. Wasn't one of your favorites, then? No, he wasn't. He was a good clarinet player, though.

ctx.x: Yeah. That was my favorite one. He was. Johnny Dawson. I knew him in Chicago. He was wonderful then, I thought. Mm-hmm. Used to play here, man. I'd run. Got to hear that bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo I'd love to hear that man play playing. I noticed you sound, sometimes, some of the things you do sound quite a bit like that. Yeah, I used to listen to him so much. I used to listen to the dots all the time. I'd love to hear that man play. What was it, can there…
Yeah. Did you ever hear Big Eye Louie much? Louie Nelson? Yeah, I never heard him much. I never didn't worry about him too much.
Wasn't one of your favorites, then? No, he wasn't. He was a good clarinet player, though. Man, that's one of them. Freddie Kepler men's, too. He was Freddie Kepler for quite a while, though.
